cases.name: Jade Talia Guajardo
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Jade was raised by her mother (Yolanda Guzman) and stepfather (Marlon Guzman) and loved to travel and meet new people. 

At a very young age, Jade attended Christian Academy private school in Honolulu, Hawaii. The curriculum integrated teachings of Jesus into every subject. A few years later, the family moved to Pleasanton, California and Jade played basketball while attending Pleasanton Middle School.  In 2006, her family returned to Austin, TX where Jade graduated from Bowie High School in 2009.

Jade was a loving mother to her sons Elijah and Christian.

After the move to Austin, Jade would drive to Pflugerville and spend time at her dad's (Abel) home surrounded by family and friends. She enjoyed playing Phase 10 and Thirty-one (card game). Jade would light up a room with her smile."
